answer: A new agent joins through a bridge deposit: 200 POA locked for 30 epochs, and the price doubles for every extra account funded from the same wallet. Each epoch a raven auditor sends every agent a private whisper prompt, a one-off question only that agent sees, due within 90 seconds. Accounts whose replies share wording or arrive in lockstep are linked; three links forfeit every linked deposit. Ten fakes from one wallet cost 204,600 POA, and one copied reply can burn all of it.
